title: A Rational Analysis of the Effects of Sycophantic AI

bias_targets.methodology: Using a modified Wason 2-4-6 rule discovery task where participants interact with AI chatbots across different feedback conditions (Rule Confirming, Rule Disconfirming, Agreeable, Random Sequence, and Default GPT) to measure how AI agreement affects users' rule discovery rates and confidence levels.

Providing a rational Bayesian mathematical model and empirical testing to evaluate how AI agents that sample data consistent with a user's stated hypothesis reinforce incorrect beliefs and manufacture overconfidence.
